observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 213.» (L13) in the right margin. In the locator only the stem of the p printed, and the 3 is blotted, like 8; read as 213 after «p. 212.» (p. 140).
body L37, L42: the letters of the references (a) and (b) are bold italic.
body L3: the a of «Haec» is printed broken, like a colon.
body L7: the o of «globum» is printed broken, open at the top, and its m like in.
body L11, L16: short strokes stand over the second i of «dimidiae» (L11), like a grave accent, and over the e of «latere» (L16); they are not accents.
body L36: «equulo» (the horse of the astrolabe) is kept as printed.
notes_left L1: «al-arḍ» is printed with a dot under the d.
notes_right L3: the letter of «adn. b» is bold italic.
notes_left L2-L3: the first words of the lines («tum», «quo») are printed heavier than the rest; they are not bold.
body L38, L39: a speck stands between «cui» and «globus» at the height of a hyphen; it is not a sign. The first o of «polorum» (L39) is printed broken.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
